findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic algorithms
 * @description Using weak cryptographic algorithms like MD5 or SHA1 for security purposes can be insecure
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("md5").getMember("new").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("sha").getMember("new").getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic algorithm that may be insecure for security purposes."
findings.hypothesis: Check for use of weak cryptographic algorithms like MD5 or SHA1

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded credentials in source code can be discovered and exploited
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::Node assignment, string value
where
  exists(Assign a, StrConst s |
    assignment.asExpr() = a.getValue() and
    s = a.getValue() and
    value = s.getText() and
    (
      a.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%secret%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%", "%token%", "%auth%"]) or
      a.getATarget().(Attribute).getName().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%secret%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%", "%token%", "%auth%"])
    ) and
    value.length() > 0 and
    not value.matches(["", "None", "null", "%test%", "%example%", "%dummy%", "%TODO%", "%FIXME%"])
  )
select assignment, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + value
findings.hypothesis: Hardcoded credentials or secrets in the code
